Subject: Next steps — evaluation close & e-sign timing

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Ava Retail's evaluation team wrapped their final performance passes today — overall thumbs up, a couple of edge-case prompts (outlined in the attached MAP excerpt) that we want to monitor post-launch.

We're ready to lock the mutual action plan and get the SOW into legal review. Two asks to get to go/no-go on our side:

1) Can you confirm the final MAP (with the monitoring checkpoints) and the SOW redline window?
2) We need a clear e-sign window that aligns with our procurement cutover — ideally we need everything signed and invoiced by 2026-09-10 to start on 2026-09-15.

Proposed immediate timeline:
- 2026-09-03: Redwood final MAP + updated SOW delivered to Ava legal
- 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-10: Legal review & e-sign window
- 2026-09-15: Proposed production start (pilot canary, week 1)

I've attached the MAP excerpt and our internal kickoff checklist for reference. If you need a later start date we'll need to adjust the procurement window.

Regards,
Samir

Director of Platform, Ava Retail

- I'll route the SOW to Legal (internal) and Finance for a fast-track review as soon as Ben uploads the redlines.
- Our security/compliance checklist for private deployments is already green; I'll attach the checklist summary once moved to the deal file.
- Final approvals required on the Redwood side: Sales Ops (me), Sales Lead (Ben), Legal (external + our counsel), Finance (billing commit).

Two small asks to guarantee 9/15 start:
1) Ben — can you confirm the SOW version you'll send and the list of non-negotiable SLAs we must hit?
2) Samir / Ava legal — please confirm the signatory (name + role) who will sign on 9/7–9/10 so we can prep DocuSign routing.

If we get those items in the next 48 hours, we'll push the DocuSign envelope on 9/7 with a 72-hour sign window. Otherwise we'll need to slide start to 9/22.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the internal approval checklist later today.

Best,
